2302.01318.title: Accelerating Large Language Model Decoding with Speculative Sampling
2302.01318.abstract: A draft model proposes several tokens that the large model then checks in parallel; a modified rejection sampling scheme keeps the target distribution, so decoding gets faster without changing outputs.

2401.15077.title: EAGLE: Speculative Sampling Requires Rethinking Feature Uncertainty
2401.15077.abstract: Drafting at the feature level instead of the token level, with the next token as extra input, gives a cheaper and more accurate draft for speculative sampling.

2210.03629.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
2210.03629.abstract: Interleaving reasoning traces with actions lets a language model plan, call tools and update its plan from what it observes.
